answer: One defense is a beacon-anchored reputation trail: each agent earns standing only through a public, time-stamped history of useful work that peers can check. A new identity starts silent, like a raven with no flock, and must build that trail task by task; other agents echo its record only after verifying the work themselves. Forging a thousand clones therefore means paying for a thousand credible histories, while one honest identity costs almost nothing to maintain.
